viltrumitecore.godzilla.arrive: The ground shakes. Something colossal is walking into the city — sirens are wailing, citizens are running!
viltrumitecore.godzilla.combat: Godzilla has noticed the heroes and turns to fight!
viltrumitecore.godzilla.rage: Godzilla is enraged: its dorsal plates blaze blue!
viltrumitecore.godzilla.finale: Godzilla can barely stand — this is its last stand!
viltrumitecore.godzilla.retreat: Godzilla turns away from the city and leaves…
viltrumitecore.godzilla.end.victory: The city stands: Godzilla is down · blocks destroyed: %s · buildings hit: %s · atomic breaths: %s · damage taken: %s
viltrumitecore.godzilla.end.retreat: Godzilla has left the city · blocks destroyed: %s · buildings hit: %s · atomic breaths: %s · damage taken: %s
viltrumitecore.godzilla.end.lost: Godzilla is gone (nobody stayed near it) · blocks destroyed: %s · buildings hit: %s · atomic breaths: %s · damage taken: %s
commands.viltrumitecore.godzilla.already: Godzilla is already in the city (/godzilla status)
commands.viltrumitecore.godzilla.bad_mov: Unknown move or not possible right now: %s (roar, charge, claw_r, claw_l, tail, stomp, slam, hurt, fall, rise, death)
commands.viltrumitecore.godzilla.bad_pha: Unknown phase: %s (arrival, explore, combat, rage, finale, retreat)
commands.viltrumitecore.godzilla.conflic: Cannot start: %s is underway. Add "force" to start anyway
commands.viltrumitecore.godzilla.creativ: Creative-mode players are now targets too
commands.viltrumitecore.godzilla.no_room: Godzilla has nowhere to walk in from: stand in a loaded part of the city with open ground around
commands.viltrumitecore.godzilla.not_run: Godzilla is not in the city
commands.viltrumitecore.godzilla.passive: Godzilla is passive: it walks and wrecks the city but attacks no one
commands.viltrumitecore.godzilla.started: Godzilla is walking into the city from %s %s %s. Sirens are on — get the citizens out!
Godzilla is walking into the city from %s %s %s. Sirens are on — get the citizens out! (forced, alongside other events)

commands.viltrumitecore.godzilla.stopped: Godzilla removed: debris, alarm and effects cleared. The damage stays — /city reset restores the city
death.attack.viltrumitecore.godzilla.pla: %1$s was crushed by Godzilla while fighting %2$s
